coreAttributes.name: Cultist's Mystery Potion
coreAttributes.description:
An ornate glass bottle, filled with a considerable amount of rainbow-coloured liquid. A label attached to the neck of the bottle reads:
[style.italicsArcane(Accept this gift from the Cult of Lilith! Your queen demands your transformation, so drink it all and praise Lilith!)]

useDescriptions.selfUse: [npc.Name] [npc.verb(pull)] out the stopper from the Cultist's Mystery Potion bottle and instantly [npc.verb(recoil)] as an overwhelming myriad of sweet, sour, bitter, and pungent smells assault [npc.her] senses. Despite [npc.her] better judgement, [npc.she] [npc.verb(bring)] the bottle to [npc.her] [npc.lips+] and [npc.verb(swallow)] down every last drop of the concoction, discovering in the process that its taste is every bit as wild and varied as its aroma.
useDescriptions.otherUse: [npc.Name] [npc.verb(pull)] out the stopper from the Cultist's Mystery Potion bottle, before bringing it up to [npc2.namePos] waiting [npc2.lips]. [npc2.She] [npc2.verb(recoil)] as an overwhelming myriad of sweet, sour, bitter, and pungent smells assault [npc2.her] senses, but [npc2.she] nevertheless [npc2.verb(swallow)] down every last drop of the concoction, discovering in the process that its taste is every bit as wild and varied as its aroma.
